english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who shows strong enthusiasm or passion.
Use this for a person’s warm, cordial attitude or an enthusiastic welcome or show of support.
This is the all-purpose choice for warm, strongly felt romantic affection or enthusiasm, though it is less explicitly sexual than 「好有激情」.

examples.english: They are always enthusiastic and warm toward people.
